label: Home
behaviour: Opens the start page: create a new document from a blank page or a template, or reopen a recent one.

label: Draft with Copilot: Create prompt
behaviour: Takes a description of the document wanted for the cloud writing assistant; unavailable without that service.

label: Add content
behaviour: Attaches files or references for the writing assistant to draw on when it drafts the document.

label: Dictation
behaviour: Lets the description for the writing assistant be spoken instead of typed; needs a microphone.

label: Create
behaviour: Sends the description to the writing assistant to draft a new document; disabled until a description is entered.

label: New
behaviour: Shows or hides the row of templates for a new document.

label: More templates
behaviour: Opens the New page with every available template.

label: Templates
behaviour: Lists templates, a blank document first; choosing one creates a new document from it.

label: Recent
behaviour: Shows the documents opened most recently in the list below.

label: Favorites
behaviour: Shows the documents marked as favourites in the list below.

label: Shared with Me
behaviour: Shows documents other people have shared with the signed-in account; needs an online account.

label: Search for a file
behaviour: Filters the documents listed below by name as it is typed.

label: Recent
behaviour: Lists recent documents; choosing one opens it.

label: More documents
behaviour: Opens the Open page with the full list of recent documents.

label: New
behaviour: Creates a new document: blank, or from a template found by browsing or searching.

label: Search for online templates
behaviour: Takes words to search the online template catalogue for.

label: Start searching
behaviour: Searches the online templates for the words entered; needs an internet connection.

label: Suggested searches
behaviour: Offers common template searches; choosing one runs it.

label: Open
behaviour: Opens an existing document from a recent list, an online account or a folder on this PC.

label: Recent
behaviour: Lists recently opened documents and folders to open again.

label: Shared with Me
behaviour: Lists documents shared with the signed-in account; needs an online account.

label: OneDrive
behaviour: Browses the signed-in account's cloud storage for a document to open.

label: Show more...
behaviour: Shows the rest of the account's storage places in this list.

label: This PC
behaviour: Browses folders on this PC for a document to open.

label: Add a Place
behaviour: Connects another online storage service so its documents can be opened here.

label: Browse
behaviour: Opens the system's file dialog to pick a document anywhere.

label: Search for a file
behaviour: Filters the recent documents by name as it is typed.

label: Recover Unsaved Documents
behaviour: Opens the folder of documents that were closed without being saved, to recover one.

label: Info
behaviour: Shows the open document's details: protection, inspection, versions and properties.

label: Protect Document
behaviour: Opens the choices for controlling who can open or change the document.

label: Always Open Read-Only
behaviour: Makes the document suggest opening read only, so changes are not made by accident.

label: Encrypt with Password
behaviour: Encrypts the document so it opens only with a password.

label: Restrict Editing
behaviour: Limits which kinds of change people can make to the document.

label: Restrict Access
behaviour: Limits who can open, copy or print the document, through the organisation's rights service.

label: Add a Digital Signature
behaviour: Signs the document with a digital certificate, so changes after signing show.

label: Mark as Final
behaviour: Marks the document as finished and opens it read only for readers.

label: Check for Issues
behaviour: Opens the checks to run on the document before it is shared.

label: Inspect Document
behaviour: Finds hidden data and personal information in the document to remove before sharing.

label: Check Accessibility
behaviour: Finds content people with disabilities may find hard to read.

label: Check Compatibility
behaviour: Lists features older versions of the program do not support.

label: Version History
behaviour: Lists earlier saved versions of the document to view or restore; needs a document saved to an online account.

label: Manage Document
behaviour: Opens the choices for recovering or deleting unsaved copies of documents.

label: Recover Unsaved Documents
behaviour: Opens the folder of documents closed without being saved.

label: Delete All Unsaved Documents
behaviour: Deletes every unsaved recovery copy, after asking.

label: Manage Document
behaviour: Lists automatic recovery copies of this document; empty when there are none.

label: Properties
behaviour: Opens the choices for viewing every property of the document.

label: Advanced Properties
behaviour: Opens the dialog with every property of the document.

label: Size
behaviour: Shows the document's file size; read only.

label: Pages
behaviour: Shows the document's page count; read only.

label: Words
behaviour: Shows the document's word count; read only.

label: Total Editing Time
behaviour: Shows how long the document has been open for editing; read only.

label: Title
behaviour: Edits the document's title property, stored in the file.

label: Tags
behaviour: Edits the document's keywords, stored in the file and used by search.

label: Comments
behaviour: Edits the document's comments property, stored in the file.

label: Author
behaviour: Adds a person as an author of the document by typing a name.

label: Verify Names
behaviour: Checks the names typed against the address book.

label: Browse Address Book
behaviour: Opens the address book to pick an author.

label: Last Modified By
behaviour: Shows who last saved the document; read only until it has been saved.

label: Verify Names
behaviour: Checks the name shown against the address book.

label: Browse Address Book
behaviour: Opens the address book for the last editor's entry.

label: Show All Properties
behaviour: Expands the list to every property the document carries.

label: Save
behaviour: Saves the document where it was last saved; for a new document it opens Save As instead.

label: Save As
behaviour: Saves the document under a new name, place or format.

label: Recent
behaviour: Lists recently used folders to save into.

label: OneDrive
behaviour: Saves into the signed-in account's cloud storage.

label: Show more...
behaviour: Shows the rest of the account's storage places in this list.

label: Share
behaviour: Saves the document online and opens sharing for it.

label: Copy Link
behaviour: Saves the document online and copies a link to it.

label: This PC
behaviour: Saves into a folder on this PC.

label: Add a Place
behaviour: Connects another online storage service to save into.

label: Browse
behaviour: Opens the system's save dialog to pick any folder.

label: Navigate Up
behaviour: Moves up to the folder containing the one shown.

label: Enter file name here
behaviour: Takes the name the document is saved under.

label: Save as type
behaviour: Chooses the file format the document is saved in.

label: Word Document (*.docx)
behaviour: Saves the document in the Word Document (*.docx) format.

label: Word Macro-Enabled Document (*.docm)
behaviour: Saves the document in the Word Macro-Enabled Document (*.docm) format.

label: Word 97-2003 Document (*.doc)
behaviour: Saves the document in the Word 97-2003 Document (*.doc) format.

label: Word Template (*.dotx)
behaviour: Saves the document in the Word Template (*.dotx) format.

label: Word Macro-Enabled Template (*.dotm)
behaviour: Saves the document in the Word Macro-Enabled Template (*.dotm) format.

label: Word 97-2003 Template (*.dot)
behaviour: Saves the document in the Word 97-2003 Template (*.dot) format.

label: PDF (*.pdf)
behaviour: Saves the document in the PDF (*.pdf) format.

label: XPS Document (*.xps)
behaviour: Saves the document in the XPS Document (*.xps) format.

label: Single File Web Page (*.mht, *.mhtml)
behaviour: Saves the document in the Single File Web Page (*.mht, *.mhtml) format.

label: Web Page (*.htm, *.html)
behaviour: Saves the document in the Web Page (*.htm, *.html) format.

label: Web Page, Filtered (*.htm, *.html)
behaviour: Saves the document in the Web Page, Filtered (*.htm, *.html) format.

label: Rich Text Format (*.rtf)
behaviour: Saves the document in the Rich Text Format (*.rtf) format.

label: Plain Text (*.txt)
behaviour: Saves the document in the Plain Text (*.txt) format.

label: Word XML Document (*.xml)
behaviour: Saves the document in the Word XML Document (*.xml) format.

label: Word 2003 XML Document (*.xml)
behaviour: Saves the document in the Word 2003 XML Document (*.xml) format.

label: Strict Open XML Document (*.docx)
behaviour: Saves the document in the Strict Open XML Document (*.docx) format.

label: OpenDocument Text (*.odt)
behaviour: Saves the document in the OpenDocument Text (*.odt) format.

label: Sensitivity
behaviour: Chooses the organisation's sensitivity label for the document; shown only where labels are set up.

label: Save
behaviour: Saves the document with the name, place and format chosen.

label: Learn More
behaviour: Opens help about the sensitivity labels.

label: More options...
behaviour: Opens the system's full save dialog.

label: New Folder
behaviour: Creates a folder in the folder shown.

label: Sort by name: sorted ascending
behaviour: Sorts the folders and files listed by name; pressed again it reverses the order.

label: Sort by date modified
behaviour: Sorts the folders and files listed by when they last changed.

label: Items
behaviour: Lists the folders and documents in the folder shown; choosing a folder opens it.

label: Print
behaviour: Prints the document, with the printer, the pages and the layout chosen, beside a preview.

label: Print
behaviour: Prints the document with the settings chosen.

label: Copies
behaviour: Sets how many copies to print.

label: Which Printer
behaviour: Chooses the printer; its entries are the printers installed on this PC.

label: Printer Properties
behaviour: Opens the selected printer's own settings.

label: Print What
behaviour: Chooses what to print: all or some pages, or a list such as the document's styles.

label: Print All Pages
behaviour: Prints the whole document.

label: Print Selection
behaviour: Prints only the selected text; disabled when nothing is selected.

label: Print Current Page
behaviour: Prints only the page shown in the preview.

label: Custom Print
behaviour: Prints only the pages typed in the Pages box.

label: Document Info
behaviour: Prints a list of the document's properties instead of the document.

label: List of Markup
behaviour: Prints a list of the tracked changes and comments.

label: Styles
behaviour: Prints a list of the styles the document uses.

label: AutoText Entries
behaviour: Prints a list of the stored AutoText entries.

label: Key Assignments
behaviour: Prints a list of the custom keyboard shortcuts.

label: Print Markup
behaviour: Includes tracked changes and comments in the printout; ticked or not.

label: Only Print Odd Pages
behaviour: Prints only odd-numbered pages.

label: Only Print Even Pages
behaviour: Prints only even-numbered pages.

label: Pages
behaviour: Takes the page numbers or ranges to print.

label: Two-Sided Printing
behaviour: Chooses printing on one side or both sides of the paper.

label: Print One Sided
behaviour: Prints on one side of each sheet.

label: Print on Both Sides
behaviour: Prints on both sides of each sheet, turning pages on the long edge; needs a printer that prints both sides.

label: Print on Both Sides
behaviour: Prints on both sides of each sheet, turning pages on the short edge; needs a printer that prints both sides.

label: Manually Print on Both Sides
behaviour: Prints one side, then asks for the paper to be put back in to print the other.

label: Collation
behaviour: Chooses whether multiple copies print as whole sets or page by page.

label: Collated
behaviour: Prints each copy as a whole set before starting the next.

label: Uncollated
behaviour: Prints every copy of each page before moving to the next page.

label: Orientation
behaviour: Chooses portrait or landscape for the printout.

label: Portrait Orientation
behaviour: Prints pages taller than they are wide.

label: Landscape Orientation
behaviour: Prints pages wider than they are tall.

label: Page Size
behaviour: Chooses the paper size; its entries are the sizes the selected printer supports.

label: Margins
behaviour: Chooses the page margins used for printing.

label: Normal Margins
behaviour: Prints with the standard margins.

label: Narrow Margins
behaviour: Prints with narrow margins, fitting more on each page.

label: Moderate Margins
behaviour: Prints with margins between normal and narrow.

label: Wide Margins
behaviour: Prints with wide margins.

label: Mirrored Margins
behaviour: Prints with inside and outside margins that mirror on facing pages.

label: Office 2003 Default Margins
behaviour: Prints with the margins older versions of the program used by default.

label: Custom Margins...
behaviour: Opens the Page Setup dialog to set the margins.

label: Pages Per Sheet
behaviour: Chooses how many pages print on each sheet of paper.

label: 1 Page Per Sheet
behaviour: Prints 1 Page Per Sheet.

label: 2 Pages Per Sheet
behaviour: Prints 2 Pages Per Sheet.

label: 4 Pages Per Sheet
behaviour: Prints 4 Pages Per Sheet.

label: 6 Pages Per Sheet
behaviour: Prints 6 Pages Per Sheet.

label: 8 Pages Per Sheet
behaviour: Prints 8 Pages Per Sheet.

label: 16 Pages Per Sheet
behaviour: Prints 16 Pages Per Sheet.

label: Scale to Paper Size
behaviour: Scales the printout to fit a chosen paper size.

label: Page Setup
behaviour: Opens the Page Setup dialog.

label: Previous Page
behaviour: Shows the previous page of the preview; disabled on the first page.

label: Current Page
behaviour: Shows the page previewed and takes a page number to jump to.

label: Next Page
behaviour: Shows the next page of the preview; disabled on the last page.
Shows the preview's zoom level and opens the zoom choices.

label: Zoom Out
behaviour: Makes the preview smaller.

label: Zoom
behaviour: Sets the preview's zoom level by dragging.

label: Zoom In
behaviour: Makes the preview larger.

label: Zoom to Page
behaviour: Fits a whole page in the preview.

label: Share
behaviour: Shares the document with other people: by link, by e-mail or as an online presentation.

label: Share with People
behaviour: Shows how to share the document with people, after it is saved online.

label: Email
behaviour: Shows the ways to send the document by e-mail.

label: Create PDF and share link
behaviour: Shows how to save a PDF copy online and share a link to it.

label: Present Online
behaviour: Shows how to present the document to people watching in a web browser.

label: Save to Cloud
behaviour: Saves the document online so it can be shared.

label: Send as Attachment
behaviour: Opens a new e-mail with the document attached; needs a mail program.

label: Send a Link
behaviour: Opens a new e-mail with a link to the document; disabled until it is saved online.

label: Create PDF and Share via Outlook
behaviour: Saves a PDF copy and opens a new e-mail with it attached.

label: Send as PDF
behaviour: Opens a new e-mail with a PDF copy of the document attached.

label: Send as XPS
behaviour: Opens a new e-mail with an XPS copy of the document attached.

label: Send as Internet Fax
behaviour: Sends the document through an internet fax service; needs one set up.

label: Create PDF and Share link
behaviour: Saves a PDF copy online and shares a link to it.

label: Service Agreement
behaviour: Opens the terms of the online presentation service.

label: Enable remote viewers to download the document
behaviour: Lets the people watching the presentation download the document.

label: Present Online
behaviour: Starts presenting the document online and gives a link to send to viewers.

label: Export

label: Change File Type
behaviour: Shows the file formats a copy can be saved in.

label: Create PDF/XPS

label: Save As
